envelope.description: Strict github.json reader and the serialised, verified writer

body.title: Strict github.json reader and the serialised, verified writer
body.summary: Add readRepoEntry (strict level-by-level object validation, read and parse errors reported, missing file is empty), mergeRepoEntryKeys, and the daemon-side writeRepoEntryKeys: one in-process promise queue, read-validate-merge-temp write, verify size, mtime and content hash immediately before the rename with a bounded retry, write-failed and file-changed results, queue never left rejected. No lock file anywhere.
acceptanceChecks: readRepoEntry rejects every malformed level and names it, and accepts missing file, default, repos and entry
Concurrent writes for different keys all land and never overlap; a failing write does not stall the queue
A hook that changes the file after the temp write makes the writer re-merge from the new content, and after the bounded attempts return file-changed with nothing written
Temp-write and rename failures return write-failed with the operating-system message and leave the file as it was
Only the named keys change; default, other repos and unknown keys are preserved; null removes a key and is a no-op for an unset key
